locationComparison.name: Revenant Caves
notes: All eleven revenant types share the Revenant Caves (Wilderness levels 17-40).
The caves are singles-plus combat: a dwarf multicannon cannot be placed and player killers can attack you while you fight a revenant.
Density figures are not wiki-tabulated, so amount is left unknown.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 268 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Revenants is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Krystilia assigns Revenants as a Wilderness-only task (40-100, weight 5); the Revenenenenenants unlock (100 points) extends assignments to 100-150.
Being undead, revenants are susceptible to the salve amulet and its enchanted version.

The wiki states no explicit elemental or defensive weakness; the charged Wilderness weapons (Viggora's chainmace, Craw's bow, Thammaron's sceptre) of any style are the effective choice, and a revenants task from Krystilia boosts their drop rate 5x.
The Revenant Caves are singles-plus PvP with extreme player-killer risk and no cannon; bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.
Revenants heal when dropped below 50% Hitpoints and adapt their attack style to the player, so protection prayers reduce but do not stop their damage.
recommendedMethod: Kill revenants in the Revenant Caves with a charged Wilderness weapon - Viggora's chainmace (melee), Craw's bow (ranged) or Thammaron's sceptre (magic) - which are far more effective there when charged with revenant ether and gain a 5x drop rate on a Krystilia task. The wiki lists no elemental weakness, so pick the style you can sustain; wear low-risk gear, watch the minimap for player killers, and keep a one-click escape teleport ready since cannons cannot be used and the caves are singles-plus PvP.
